tags.name: z-element
tags.description: The living base: carries interaction states as :state() and emits z-state.

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Durable selection (checked, active tab) — set by a selectable component.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Status: loading / processing.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Status: error.

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Status: valid / done.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name — used only by components that submit a value.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until this control has a value.

tags.name: z-layer
tags.description: The pieces of a component — its background, its label, its tick — already painted for you. You only write a layer to take over one precise part.

attributes.name: part
attributes.description: The role this layer plays (background, marker, ring, dot, label, icon…). Shared across components: the same word means the same thing everywhere.

tags.name: z-contact
tags.description: Need a click effect across your whole page? Drop this tag anywhere — problem solved. Two effects by default; not to your taste? Make your own in a few lines of CSS.

attributes.name: fx
attributes.description: Kill switch only; the effect itself belongs to the skin.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Set by the engine on every source but the last one — the last declared wins.

tags.name: z-cursor
tags.description: The pointer's wake: one flat tag, and the mouse leaves a ribbon behind it.

attributes.name: fx
attributes.description: move (the ribbon follows the mouse, default) · click (it fuses from one click to the next) · none.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Colours the wake with the tone (main · complement · soft).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Thickness of the wake, on the shared scale (xs → xl).

tags.name: z-checkbox
tags.description: A checkbox — inherits all z-element states, marker + label anatomy, painted by the skin.

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Checked: a durable selection set by the component (click / Space).

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Neither checked nor unchecked — the state of a 'check all' box whose children disagree. Any click resolves it to checked.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: What is submitted when checked (default: "on", like the native input).

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid until this box is checked.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Invalid (e.g. required and unchecked).

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Valid.

tags.name: z-button
tags.description: A button — inherits all z-element states, skinnable by themes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: What it does inside a form: submit (default), reset, or nothing.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Loading (skeleton sweep, not clickable).

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Error (danger border + shake).

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Valid (success border).

tags.name: z-radio
tags.description: A radio button — z-element states, marker + label anatomy, selects but never unselects itself.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value this radio carries — read by z-radio-group.

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Selected: a durable selection set by the component (click / Space / Enter).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Invalid (e.g. a required choice is missing).

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Valid.

tags.name: z-radio-group
tags.description: A group of z-radio: single choice, arrow-key navigation, roving tabindex, one value.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected radio's value — set it to preselect, read it to know the choice.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the whole group.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: The group's choice is invalid (e.g. required and empty).

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: The group's choice is valid.

tags.name: z-slider
tags.description: A value slider — poses progress (0→1) in the cascade, the skin paints everything.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value. Clamped to [min, max] and snapped to step.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Lower bound (default 0).

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Upper bound (default 100).

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Increment. `any` for a continuous slider (default 1).

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Track direction. Vertical runs bottom→top: up means more.

attributes.name: markers
attributes.description: Graduations. Bare = one per step; a number = that many intervals.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Where the value is written, relative to the track. `none` (default) writes nothing.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

tags.name: z-badge
tags.description: A status/count pill — inherits z-element's tone & size variants, painted by the skin. Almost zero code: the frozen socle does the work.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Importance/colour, from the socle variant.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size factor, from the socle variant (everything follows in em).

tags.name: z-tag
tags.description: A tag/chip for keywords, filters, categories — inherits tone & size; optionally removable.

attributes.name: removable
attributes.description: Shows a × ; removes on click (on the ×) or Delete/Backspace when focused.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Importance/colour, from the socle variant.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size factor, from the socle variant.

tags.name: z-switch
tags.description: An on/off switch — inherits all z-element states, form-bound, painted by the skin. Immediate effect, unlike a checkbox you'll validate later.

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: On: a durable state set by the component (click / Space).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: What is submitted when on (default: "on").

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled: blocks interaction.

tags.name: z-progress
tags.description: A progress bar — inherits z-element states + tone/size, painted by the skin. value/max → a percentage the CSS draws.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current amount (0…max).

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: The total (default 100).

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Unknown amount — a sweep animates, aria-valuenow is dropped.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Fill colour, from the socle variant.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size factor, from the socle variant.

tags.name: z-spinner
tags.description: A loading spinner — inherits tone/size, role=status with an accessible label. The ring spins in CSS.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible text read by screen readers (default: "Chargement…").

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Colour, from the socle variant.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size factor, from the socle variant.

tags.name: z-avatar
tags.description: An identity chip — an image if given, otherwise the initials. role=img with an alt from name. Inherits tone/size.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL — set as the host's background (no injected ).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The person/thing shown — becomes the accessible alt (role=img + aria-label).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size factor, from the socle variant.

tags.name: z-disclosure
tags.description: A disclosure (title → collapsible content) — inherits z-element states, accessible (aria-expanded/controls, inert when closed), animatable.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Open: reveals the panel.

tags.name: z-alert
tags.description: A contextual message — tone drives the colour, role=status (or alert for danger). Optionally dismissible.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: The kind of message — drives colour and, for danger, the live politeness.

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: Adds a × ; closes on click (on the ×) or Delete/Backspace when focused.

tags.name: z-tooltip
tags.description: A hint bubble shown on hover and keyboard focus — accessible via a [part=tip] piece wired with aria-describedby.

attributes.name: tip
attributes.description: Short form: the bubble text as an attribute (visual; prefer a [part=tip] piece for full a11y).

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Where the bubble sits (default top).
